The '''Kingdom of Lunareia''' is a mapped state neighboring [[Imperial Suomi]] in the central-eastern region of Avant.

In the 1994-back source set, Lunareia is first useful as Suomi's neighbor during the [[Tyla River Crisis]] of 1658. The old Suomi source says Lunareia attempted multiple incursions along the border during the reign of King Jarvinen I.

== Map Role ==

The 2003 and 2022 map references place Lunareia east or northeast of Imperial Suomi and south or southeast of [[Vorkutangrad]]. This draft does not fix older borders before 1658 or any later border changes.
